4. INSTALL NO.2 TILT SUB LEVER
Install the No.2 tilt sub lever to the column upper bracket.

5. SELECT NO.2 SUPPORT COLLAR
Select a No.2 collar which will eliminate all play.

6. INSTALL ADJUSTER MEMORY COVER
Install the adjuster memory cover to the ratchet of the column upper bracket.

7. INSTALL TILT-UP CONTROL LEVER AND NO.1 TILT SUB LEVER
(a) Assemble the No.1 tilt sub lever to the tilt-up control lever.

(b) Install the tilt-up control lever to the column upper bracket.
